facts.fact: Bethany 住进 walk-in pantry（最后一间等候室）；laptop/药篮/Erin 毕业照『If you can save only one, make it her』
facts.anchor: If you can save only one, make it her.

facts.fact: 罐头架（prepper 特供超大罐）；致幻剂下把罐头想成 Muppets 老头催她 hurry up and disappear
facts.anchor: Come on, little girl. It’s time to hurry up and disappear already.

facts.fact: 药效够供一个中型 EDM 音乐节；静电回归、cobwebs metastasizing、低语 take shape/open the video store
facts.anchor: Pretty soon we’ll have enough strength to take shape once again.

facts.fact: 她感受到 David 通过监控摄像头 watching（one-way mirror/petri dish），想起 West Texas 医院（locked from outside/pills/monitored 24-7）
facts.anchor: There, like here, the door to Bethany’s cell was locked from the outside

facts.fact: 静电喜欢她 powerless 的感觉，pushes against inner wall of skull
facts.anchor: Clearly, the static likes Bethany feeling powerless.

facts.fact: Jules 送早餐（罐装 rice and beans）、留门 ajar、看她像 museum 画
facts.anchor: They look at Bethany like she’s the most beautiful painting they’ve ever seen.

facts.fact: Jules 提 Tic Tacs 假自杀/Pink Eye TV 挑战帮她穿越；偷抓一把药（acid/mushrooms/ketamine）
facts.anchor: Do you mind if I grab some of these?

facts.fact: Bethany 请离开、说需要一两小时（最多三）；Jules 耳语 I'm coming with you（躲开摄像头）
结尾：她不需要 Tic Tacs/假自杀/静电视频——只需 Isolation. Powerlessness. Eternally trapped
facts.anchor: All she needs is this. Isolation. Powerlessness. The sensation of being really, truly, eternally trapped.
